title: Mixed Event — Play That Beautiful Sound! — Episode3 My Love of Music

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, life has been quiet for Toya. Just when he feels like trying something new, the owner of an instrument store who he owes a lot to asks him to deal with customers at an event!

rows.Line: The night before Shibuya Instrument Day

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Can I leave the cases for the horns here, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, that should be good!
And we'll gather up all the saxes here...

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Alright, we're done organizing all the instruments.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Tomorrow's the day!
We're still meeting at the time you sent us earlier, right?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line:
That's right!
I'm looking forward to seeing you both there tomorrow, An, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we look forward to being there.
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I've had a chance to clarify what to look out for and where to carry everything. It's a lot, but Shiraishi and I should be able to move it all before the doors open.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I can also more or less explain how each instrument works now. That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: My customer service skills...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Thanks to Shiraishi and the others, I've sort of gotten a hang of the basics...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But the more I feel the need to do well, the more I find myself tensing or freezing up.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I should practice a little more...
Just try to relax and be yourself...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
No, I'm still getting anxious.
I'll need to give this another try after I get home...
Huh? Toya? Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm?
That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I had a feeling it was you!
Funny bumping into you this late!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm just as surprised.
Are you on your way home from practice?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
We also had a meeting that ended up running a little late. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was just lending a hand getting some things set up for Shibuya Instrument Day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shibuya Instrument Day...?
Oh, isn't that the convention they're having at the hall by the station tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My mom and I were talking about that last week! Unfortunately, some stuff came up, so we can't go...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see. That is unfortunate...
I'll try to take in as much of the convention as I can in you and your family's place.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
Still, how did you end up helping out for it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The shop we often rent equipment from is going to be there as a vendor, but they found themselves suddenly short-staffed. I volunteered to help out, since they've been so good to us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'd love to see you working as one of the staff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm still very worried about my customer service skills.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, you are?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, because I've never done anything like this before. I can't seem to stop myself from tensing up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, you do always get a little anxious whenever you try something new.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Very true...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's an instrument convention, right?
That means you have nothing to worry about!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Umm...
What makes you believe that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because I know you really love music and instruments, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Remember how nervous you were the first time you came over to our house?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But when Tsukasa shouted “We're having a recital!” and started playing the piano, you immediately went over to join him. Your eyes twinkled so much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was when I realized just how much you love music. I had so much fun watching you two play together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I'm sure you'll do a great job of explaining how much fun music and instruments are!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (My memories of playing the piano back then are not very pleasant ones, for the most part.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But I always had fun whenever I got to play with Saki and Tsukasa at their house. I felt pure joy. I was happy...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Now I see.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Instead of worrying so much about providing good customer service, it may be better for me to just remember what I felt back then.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (About how much I love musical instruments. About how much I love music.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Saki...
I realize now that I may've been overthinking things a bit.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. But I think it's normal for you to be trying so hard to do well, Toya♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? A message from Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
He said, “You're late! Is everything okay? You should get back soon, since we're having curry loaded with veggies for dinner!”
Oh, he's such a worrywart.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe. I think that's normal for him.
After all, you do mean the world to him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
That's Tsukasa for you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll see you later!
Good luck tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I really appreciate it!
se_run_women_001_1
Shibuya Instrument Day

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
One more chair here and...
Okay, we're all set!

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Alright, the demo area's good to go!

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line:
The doors should be opening soon...
An, Toya, are you two ready?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we're ready whenever.

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Alright, that's great to hear!

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Then, I'm going to go submit these registration forms. I should be right back, but feel free to call me if anything happens.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Okay!
Come back soon!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought this convention was gonna be all stuffy and strait-laced, but it's been set up in a surprisingly cute way!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
They did a beautiful job of making everything blue based on this ocean theme.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
I'm getting really excited now!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Also, Toya, you seem pretty relaxed!
I was expecting you to be more nervous.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm?
Ah, about that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm feeling much better now. I was reminded of something very important yesterday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Something very important?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
About the joy of playing music. It was a crucial reminder.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I don't really get it myself, but as long as you're feeling better!
<Toya! An!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hey, you guys!
We came to visit!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <How are things coming along? You ready?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Rin, Len!
We just finished setting everything up!
Check it out!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wow, so many instruments! This is so cool! Oh, mind if we take a look around?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sure.
You're free to look as long as you stay hidden.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Okay, we'll be careful!
You don't have to worry about us while helping your customers!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Good luck, you two!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks, Rin, Len!
se_run_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line:
Hey, sorry about the wait!
The doors are just about to open!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, he came back just at the right time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's both do our best today!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Young Man
rows.Line:
Excuse me, miss?
Would you mind answering a question for me?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh!
Be right there!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Which instrument did you have a question about?

rows.Speaker: Young Man
rows.Line: I'm sort of interested in these trombones, but what's the difference between them? Some are skinny and some are wider, but what does that do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you for asking!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The thinner ones are designed to produce bright, high-pitched sounds. The wider ones require more air, but can produce a much louder and richer sound. That's probably the biggest difference between them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Would you like to try playing them?
Actually hearing what they sound like should help clarify things!

rows.Speaker: Young Man
rows.Line:
Oh, I can try playing them?
Then, if it's alright...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course!
Just give me one second to get you all set up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Wow!
An's a total pro! Even though this is her first time, it's like she's been doing this for years!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes.
I can learn a lot from her example.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(I am still a little nervous.
But...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll do a great job of explaining how much fun music and instruments are!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I should be fine.)

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line: Oh, young man, would you mind if I asked you a question?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Welcome.
Which instrument would you like me to help you with today?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line:
Actually, I haven't decided yet...
Do you have any instruments that a complete novice such as myself could possibly play?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: We were hoping to enjoy our golden years by learning to play something together.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: I have some experience playing the piano, but my husband here has never touched an instrument in his life. Do you have any recommendations for someone like that?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line: Preferably, something that sounds cool.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: An instrument that a novice can learn to play that also sounds cool...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Then, how about the saxophone?
It's the easiest to pick up out of all the wind instruments here.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Really?
It looks difficult to play...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can understand why you'd feel that way.
Not only are there all these keys, it also requires a reed to play.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I also thought that it must be an incredibly complicated instrument when I first saw one.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line: Oh, you felt the same way?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, when I was little. I didn't think it would be possible for me to operate all the keys while blowing into it at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In reality, it's not as complicated as it looks. For example, just by pressing this key, you can play C.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line: Oh, that's surprisingly simple.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It really is.
Ah, would you like to try holding it?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line:
Are you sure? If you're offering...
Hmm... It's also surprisingly easy to hold.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Really? It looks pretty heavy.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, an alto sax does weigh about 2.5 kg, so you will feel it. However, a strap will help lessen that burden quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line:
Plus, the sax sounds so good, too.
I might just be able to get her to fall in love with me all over again.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Honey...!
My husband thinks he's so funny!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe. I can tell that you two are very close.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now, would you like to try playing it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course, this is your first time, so it may be difficult to produce a proper tone... But I'm sure you'll be very thrilled when you do figure out how.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, let's go give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll get the manager.
This couple would like to try playing the saxophone. Would you mind helping get them set up?

rows.Speaker: Instrument Shop Manager
rows.Line: Ah, Aoyagi, thanks for bringing them to me! Please feel free to use these chairs, you two!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Thank you very much for the explanation, young man. You made things so easy to understand.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Gentleman
rows.Line: Yeah, you seemed to enjoy talking about instruments so much that I really want to try playing one now!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!
se_walk_men_002_1
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We saw what you did, Toya!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We're really glad for you! They seem so happy!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's nice knowing that I was able to play a small part in them understanding how fun it can be to play the saxophone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. More than a small part!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
Keep up the good work and... Uh oh!>

rows.Speaker: Young Lady
rows.Line: Excuse me. I have a question about this instrument...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll be right over to help!
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
He seems to be having a lot of fun talking to customers now.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Keep up the good work, Toya!)
